name: Starter
description: A neutral, light starter site with general-purpose sections composed into eight pages — Home, Features, Pricing, Customers with a page per story, Changelog, a Blog with a page per post, About and Contact — plus a library of 75 more blocks in the Add Section picker: five each of heroes, headers, logos, features, stats, testimonials, pricing, FAQ, CTA, footers, blog, contact, team, newsletter and about, every one drawn in the same system with its own copy and product screenshots.
tagline: A neutral light starter with 75 extra blocks
